discord.notes: Release-polished adapter with conformance tests, retry/backoff, typed delivery errors, and credentialed live smoke path. Remains preview until owner-run live credentials and validate:channels promotion evidence are verified.

slack.notes: Release-polished adapter with conformance tests, retry/backoff, typed delivery errors, and credentialed live smoke path. Remains preview until owner-run live credentials and validate:channels promotion evidence are verified.

teams.notes: Preview adapter combines Microsoft Graph chatMessage send with a loopback-only Microsoft 365 Agents SDK JWT ingress, exact owner admission grants, and a Gateway-owned digest-only replay inbox. Static source inspection confirms admitted messages reach the shared Gateway inbound handler and OutboundDispatcher, with chat/channel reply targets carried to Graph. Synthetic auth-rejection/admission tests do not establish a valid JWT tenant route, HDS runtime, or Teams API operation. Remains preview pending owner-run tenant evidence and validate:channels promotion evidence.

line.notes: Preview adapter separates direct one-use webhook-token replies from the existing durable push path. Reply attempts use digest-only durable receipts; failures are neither retried nor converted to push, while push retains the durable retry-key outbox. Source-level routing is connected, but conformance/runtime, owner credentials and targets, inbound listener lifecycle closure, and validate:channels promotion evidence remain unverified.

whatsapp.notes: Not implemented as first-party core. May be possible only through the generic third-party adapter interface.
